`final class JournalGlFrameBufferBinding`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglframebufferbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.state` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [JournalGlFrameBufferBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/state/JournalGlFrameBufferBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

A framebuffer binding that notes in a `GlStateJournal` the framebuffers and renderbuffers that JOID binds, before passing the call on.

## Description

[`JournalGlBinding.getFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/journalglbinding/#JournalGlBinding-method-getFrameBufferBinding) returns it.

## Learn more

- [The state journal](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#the-state-journal)
